levels.flavorText: From spark to civilization — every empire begins with fire.

units.description: A simple fire that warms your tribe and keeps beasts at bay.
Resourceful foragers who trade berries for gold.
The river provides. Cast your nets and watch wealth flow.
Skilled hunters bring back game worth more than its weight in gold.
Ancient wisdom turned into tribal trade routes and lasting prosperity.

milestones.description: Immortalize your tribe's story in sacred cave paintings that inspire generations.

levels.flavorText: The hammer rings on bronze. An age of tools, trade, and empire begins.

units.description: Dig deep into the earth to unearth precious copper and tin ores.
Transform raw ore into gleaming bronze, the metal of civilization.
A bustling hub of trade where bronze tools fetch handsome prices.
Bronze-hulled ships dominate trade routes, bringing wealth from distant lands.
A gleaming seat of power that draws tribute from across the known world.

milestones.description: Raise the great stones. A monument to the cosmos and your people's endurance.

eraUpgrades.description: Forge stronger tools. All production ×1.5 this era.
Establish trade networks. All buildings 15% cheaper.
Unite the clans under one banner. All production ×2.0 this era.

levels.flavorText: Pyramids pierce the sky. Your name will be written in stone for eternity.

units.description: Fertile river deltas yield abundant grain, the foundation of empire.
Engineering marvel channeling the lifeblood of civilization across vast distances.
Great stages where culture flourishes and crowds spend gold on spectacle.
Disciplined legions enforce trade agreements at sword point.
A monument for eternity. Workers from all lands flock to its shadow.

milestones.description: The world's knowledge gathered under one roof. Wisdom becomes wealth.

eraUpgrades.description: Fill the plazas with song and ceremony. All production ×1.5 this era.
Open embassies across the ancient world. All buildings 15% cheaper.
Prosperity reigns from the Nile to the Indus. All production ×2.0 this era.

levels.flavorText: Rome wasn't built in a day. But with enough gold, it can be yours.

units.description: The beating heart of Roman commerce, politics, and social life.
Spectacular games draw crowds from all corners of the empire.
Where citizens seek divine favor, tithes flow into the treasury.
Ancient trade routes connect East and West in a web of profitable exchange.
The unstoppable war machine of Rome. All roads lead to your treasury.

milestones.description: Crown the Acropolis with marble perfection. The gods themselves take notice.

eraUpgrades.description: March under the sacred banner. All production ×1.5 this era.
Connect your cities through a web of cathedrals. All buildings 15% cheaper.
Rule by heavenly decree. All production ×2.5 this era.

levels.flavorText: Castles rise, knights ride, and crusades reshape the world. Your kingdom awaits.

units.description: Grinding grain into flour that feeds armies and fills coffers.
An impregnable fortress from which you levy taxes on all who pass.
Soaring spires draw pilgrims whose donations fill the vault.
Holy warriors whose crusades bring back unimaginable riches.
The fearsome warrior-prince demands tribute from kingdoms far and wide.

milestones.description: Build the crown jewel of Gothic architecture. Faith and gold flow freely.

eraUpgrades.description: Monks preserve and spread knowledge. All production ×1.5 this era.
Mobilize your vassals for the holy cause. All buildings 20% cheaper.
The relic grants your kingdom divine favor. All production ×2.0 this era.

levels.flavorText: Art, science, and exploration converge. A new world is waiting to be discovered.

units.description: Gutenberg's invention spreads knowledge and commerce across the continent.
Scholars debate, discover, and drive economic transformation.
Renaissance masters produce works that patrons pay fortunes to own.
Caravels built here sail to new worlds, returning laden with treasure.
The master's workshop churns out inventions centuries ahead of their time.

milestones.description: Commission Michelangelo's greatest work. The ceiling of creation itself.

eraUpgrades.description: Spread ideas at the speed of ink. All production ×1.5 this era.
Crown-funded scholars optimise everything. All buildings 20% cheaper.
Newton, Copernicus, Galileo — they all worked for you. All production ×2.5.

levels.flavorText: Steam, steel, and smoke. The machine age reshapes civilization overnight.

units.description: Black gold powers the engines of industry. Dig deep and reap the rewards.
Watt's revolution multiplies the productivity of every worker tenfold.
Iron rails connect distant markets in a vast network of commerce.
Mass production transforms raw materials into rivers of gold.
Edison's dream made real. Electric light and industry power a new era.

milestones.description: The Great Exhibition showcases your empire's industrial supremacy to the world.

eraUpgrades.description: Harness the power of steam across every industry. All production ×1.5 this era.
Control the fuel supply, control the economy. All buildings 20% cheaper.
Factory towns span the continent. All production ×2.0 this era.

levels.flavorText: One small step. One civilization's giant leap into the stars.

units.description: Broadcast innovation to the world, turning signals into gold.
Algorithms optimize every aspect of production in the digital revolution.
Eyes in the sky open global communications and untapped energy markets.
Manned missions bring back knowledge and resources from beyond Earth.
Humanity's first permanent home beyond Earth, mining resources from the moon.

milestones.description: Unite the nations of Earth in a permanent orbital platform for all humanity.

eraUpgrades.description: Fusion power makes everything run faster. All production ×1.5 this era.
The internet optimises every supply chain. All buildings 15% cheaper.
Asteroid mining and orbital platforms. All production ×2.5 this era.

characters.quote: Fire is the first gift we gave ourselves.
An eye for an eye, a trade for a trade.
Veni, vidi, vici — and I invested wisely.
The present is theirs; the future, for which I worked, is mine.

offlineSheet.body: Your citizens kept working while you were away.

Lead your people into the Classical era.
Usher in an age of art, science, and exploration.
Power your empire with steam and iron.
Reach the Space Age — humanity's final frontier.
Earn 1 million gold across your civilization.
Accumulate 1 billion gold in your treasury.
Earn 1 trillion gold. Rome wasn't built in a day.
1 quadrillion gold earned. Economists weep.
1 quintillion gold. You have transcended economics.
Found your first new empire. The cycle of history begins.
Five empires risen and fallen by your hand.
Ten civilizations. History bends to your will.
25 empires — your legacy is written in the stars.
50 resets. Time itself is your empire.
Complete your first Wonder of the ancient world.
Three Wonders completed. The world stands in awe.
Five Wonders — your civilization echoes through history.
All eight Wonders stand. You are the greatest builder ever known.
Complete the International Space Station. Humanity reaches the stars.
Own 10 buildings total. Every empire starts small.
50 buildings — your skyline is taking shape.
200 buildings — a proper civilization takes form.
500 buildings — a city of epic proportions.
1,000 buildings. You don't need a map — you are the map.
Play for 1 real hour. Your journey begins.
10 hours of real playtime. Your citizens never sleep.
50 hours. History will remember your dedication.
100 hours of playtime. Historians will write books about you.
500 hours. You have outlasted every civilization you've built.
